message: 見える世界
I borrowed a book from the library and came up to the plaza on the hill.
It was a warm, clear autumn day just before winter. Every once in a while, I felt like reading outdoors.
I wanted to ask Melilot for a recommended spot, but unfortunately, she had stepped away from her desk.

name: Paqy
message: 「You came all the way up to a high place like this just to read a book?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, people rarely come up here, after all. If someone saw me in the courtyard or somewhere, I'd look pretentious and it'd be embarrassing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's your reason?!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot?」
I ran into the very person I was looking for. With a serious expression, Melilot was gazing at Finis Tower, rising tall and solitary in the distance.
It wasn't clear whether she had noticed me or not.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello?」
This time, Melilot turned her face toward me.
And then, a silence as if she were sizing me up.

name: Melilot
message: 「Is there something you need?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about reading around here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a good thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot, do you have any other recommended reading spots?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do not.」
Giving a library patron such a terse and exact answer--that really is so like Melilot.

name: Melilot
message: 「Taking a book that piques your interest at the moment, bringing it to a place you like, and opening it--that is the right answer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, where would be good, I wonder...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come here to read too, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something like that... I am not turning pages, though it is for contemplation that leads to reading...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To me, this is the center of the world. From here, I can look out over everything...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In this world, there are so many books that one could never finish reading them all, even if it took a lifetime.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, I would like to try reading it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps those who built that tower thought the same thing.」
I-It's too difficult, so I don't really get what she's talking about.

name: Melilot
message: 「If you don't mind my personal recommendation rather than one as a librarian, I can tell you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please, tell me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Anywhere outdoors is fine. Just one thing...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Try reading your book while lying down. Just doing that will change your impression of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so? I'll try it right away.」
I take a few steps through the grass and lie down on my back.
Instantly, the way the scenery looked changed.
The various colors I had been seeing until then receded, and white clouds and blue sky spread across my entire field of vision.
With the scent of earth and grass rising from beneath my back, I gradually feel at peace.
Even though I came here wanting to read, I end up staying still like this for a while.
Before long, the rustling of branches and leaves at the edge of the woods a short distance away. I become able to hear the sound of the tide from the pier far in the distance.
Then, gradually, the illusion that my own body is shrinking.
In inverse proportion to that, I feel as though Finis Tower is coming closer and closer toward me.
Even though it ought to be cold with winter approaching, the sensation coming through my back is somehow warm.

name: Synn
message: 「Nodding off... zzz, zzz, zzz.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe.」
